ollama provider fixes, custom model fixes #168

fix: strip top_p and guard temperature for Claude 4.x Anthropic models

Claude 4.x models reject requests that specify both temperature and
top_p simultaneously (HTTP 400). Additionally, Opus 4.x models and
claude-3-7-sonnet have deprecated the temperature parameter entirely
(also HTTP 400).

- Remove top_p from all Anthropic API requests
- Skip temperature for model IDs starting with claude-opus-4- or
  claude-3-7-sonnet; all other models keep their configured temperature

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix: use unique filename per xAI TTS generation to avoid Windows file-lock PermissionError

Previously every xAI TTS call wrote to the same fixed filename (output.wav), which could still be locked by playback on Windows, causing a PermissionError on the second consecutive generation. This generates a unique filename per call instead, so writes never collide with a file still in use.

Add Eden AI as an LLM provider (EU, OpenAI-compatible gateway)

Registers Eden AI following the same pattern as the OpenRouter provider:
new EdenAILLM wrapper (OpenAI-compatible, via OpenAILike), launcher
registration, config + settings + locale entries, and a prepare_client_args
branch. Eden AI is an EU-based, GDPR-compliant gateway exposing 700+ models
across vendors behind a single key (endpoint https://api.edenai.run/v3).

fix(remote_store): make the after_update hook reachable

RemoteStore.update() calls self.after_update(self._get_provider()) with
one argument, but the hook requires (provider, store). The TypeError is
swallowed by the surrounding except Exception: pass, so the assistant
dialog store list is silently never refreshed after a store is saved.
store is unused by the hook body, so give it a default.
